title: Remove 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA from wizard screen itself and from active-run screens
goal: Visual audit 2026-05-03 confirms the 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA (cyan pill button in topbar) appears on EVERY screen — including the wizard screen itself (where it is self-referential and confusing) and on Mission Control when a run is active (where it implies the operator should leave to do intake). The CTA makes sense only when there is NO active engagement or run. Fix the visibility condition: hide the CTA when (a) the user is already on the wizard screen, (b) a run is queued or running, (c) an engagement exists with at least one run. Show it only when no engagements exist or when the dashboard checklist indicates first-run setup is needed. Implement in app.js renderTopbarCTA() or equivalent function — gate on state.engagements.length === 0 or state.selectedRun === null and no runs exist.
scope: Visual audit 2026-05-03: screenshots 01-wizard.png and 04-mission-control.png both show the 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA button in the topbar. On the wizard screen it reads 'Complete Assessment Wizard' while the user is mid-wizard — contradictory. On Mission Control during an empty-run state it implies the user needs to go back to intake.
generation_reason: Visual audit 2026-05-03: 'Complete Assessment Wizard' CTA visible on wizard screen itself and on Mission Control — confusing and counterproductive.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only change the visibility condition of the CTA. Do not change topbar layout or wizard navigation.

success_criteria: The CTA is hidden when the active screen is 'wizard'.
The CTA is hidden when a run is queued or running.
The CTA is hidden when engagements with runs exist.
The CTA is visible on Dashboard when no engagements exist.
